purpose: Freeze the IQ2 4K, 8K, and 16K context-sensitivity ladder before canonical measurement.
hypotheses: Increasing actual prompt length with context allocation will increase TTFT and total latency.
Longer active KV context will reduce decode throughput and increase allocated VRAM.
IQ2 is expected to remain fully GPU-offloaded and technically viable at 16K with Q8 K/V cache.

measurement_order.limitation: The fixed ascending order can correlate model temperature and time with context size; continuous telemetry is retained.

workload_scaling.line: Record NNNNN: amber cedar delta frost harbor juniper lunar meadow quartz river summit violet.

calibration_before_protocol.endpoint: local llama.cpp tokenizer and one non-canonical one-token chat request
calibration_before_protocol.tokenizer_observation: The fixed record line added 24 tokens per record over the tested range.

sensible_context_criteria.technical_viability: Server starts without OOM, all 66 layers remain on CUDA0, and all canonical runs pass.
sensible_context_criteria.scope: These are study-specific interactive-use thresholds, not universal hardware requirements.

comparison_rules.primary_prefill_metrics: actual prompt tokens, prompt tokens per second, and streaming TTFT
comparison_rules.decode_metric: mean server generation tokens per second for 128 completion tokens
comparison_rules.memory_metric: startup KV allocation plus sampled peak VRAM and minimum free VRAM
comparison_rules.quality_claim: None; the synthetic fixture is not graded for model quality.

exit_condition: All attempted contexts are preserved and the largest tested context meeting the frozen viability and sensible-use criteria is identified without claiming untested full-window input capacity.
